messages.author: 990a51d339768bdf
messages.subject: Unexpected box plot behavior
parts:
Hi, I'm trying to create some box plots using pre-computed summary statistics and the results are not coming out as expected.  I assume it's a bug, but was curious if someone would be able to identify if it's something that I'm doing wrong.  Here's a simplified version of the code I'm running.

library(ggplot2)
abc <- data.frame(x=c(1,2),ymin=c(1,2),lower=c(10,12),middle=c(20,24),upper=c(30,36),ymax=c(40,42))
ggplot(abc, aes(x=x,ymin=ymin,lower=lower,middle=middle,upper=upper,ymax=ymax)) + geom_boxplot(stat="identity")

 The resulting graph is attached.  The whiskers and the median lines display correctly, but the boxes are messed up.  Anyone else noticed this behavior?

Thanks!

Ken

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: Unexpected box plot behavior
parts:
Hi:

It works if x is coerced to factor. The tipoff is the scale values on
the x-axis; if you want to maintain the numeric nature of x, you have
to use the group aesthetic. Both of the following work:

abc <- data.frame(x=c(1,2), ymin=c(1,2),lower=c(10,12), middle=c(20,24),
upper=c(30,36), ymax=c(40,42))

ggplot(abc, aes(x=factor(x), ymin=ymin, lower=lower, middle=middle,
upper=upper, ymax=ymax)) +
geom_boxplot(stat="identity")

ggplot(abc, aes(x=x, ymin=ymin, lower=lower, middle=middle,
upper=upper, ymax=ymax)) +
geom_boxplot(aes(group = x), stat="identity")


Dennis

Thanks, Dennis!  That was very helpful.

Ken
